name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Arena v2 step 3 centers the proven persistent BP_LevelObject_TowerLockBarrier_C on the resolved raid boss, scales it once to 3.0x horizontal / 1.8x vertical, places online players on a safe 1750-unit ring inside the arena, and keeps tracked raid players within a 3200-unit radius. The authoritative replicated bLocked state remains the visual activation mechanism. No repeated component visibility/replication mutation, custom RPC, Niagara call, collision mutation or AI mutation is used. No client installation required.
